title: Chapter close — The Descartes Universe
html: The orbital Fourier decomposition and the five-fold chart covering complete the intrinsic cohomology of \Sigma_4. The final section of this chapter examines how the Bring fibre varies between the substrate anchor q_0 and its half-twist q_0^{1/2}, identifying the inter-nucleon colour-tube channel and the sheet-swap realization of charge conjugation.
